question: Lai Haraoba is the earliest form of dance that forms the basis of all stylist dances of ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Manipur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lai Haraoba festival is widely celebrated in Manipur__.
 
• It is an important festival of the **Meitei** tribe.
 
• Lai Haraoba festival is celebrated in honour of __Umang-Lais__, the deity of forest and environment.
 
• In the Meitei society following types of Lai Haraoba are prevalent:
 __
 
• Kanglei Haraoba
 
• Chakpa Haraoba
 
• Moirang Haraoba
 
• Kakching Haraoba 
 
 
 
• Traditional folk dances of Manipur:__ Rakhal, Nat Rash, Maha Rash, Raukhat
